artifacts.summary: Split MintBound.lean (15,684 lines) into 18 modules plus a 121-line aggregator, extracting the C9 do-not-re-attempt register into its own declaration-free module, with all 751 declaration names and proof terms preserved.

completion_data.completion_summary: Decomposed FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/Verified/Termination/MintBound.lean from a single 15,684-line file into 18 modules under MintBound/, retaining MintBound.lean as a 121-line aggregator that declares nothing and preserves the downstream interface exactly (Decidability.lean has a zero-line diff). The C9 do-not-re-attempt register is now Register.lean, the only module with zero declarations, so a reader can tell locally whether a passage is a live result or a record of a refuted approach. All 751 declaration names and all proof terms are preserved byte-for-byte; the only semantic change is sixteen declarations losing a private modifier they could not keep across a module boundary. lake build is green, sorry-free and axiom-free, and scripts/check-module-invariants.sh now exits 0 — including INV and C9, which were failing before this task began.
